title: Green Account (savings): How your savings help the environment
summary: Explains how Green Account (savings) deposits and interest affect the environment: 10% of interest goes to verified carbon offset programs, 15% of deposits finance renewable energy, and 2 trees are planted per $1,000 average balance. Also provides estimated impact: $0.50 tons CO2 offset annually per $10,000 average balance, plus monthly environmental impact reports and tips (higher average balance, keep earning interest) to increase metrics.
